purpose: Miss the opportunity to carry out an intended action.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Vます stem + そびれる
I waited for a chance to speak and missed saying it.
I was busy and missed lunch.
I missed the chance to wave at the ticket gate.
formation: Vます stem + そびれる
restrictions: The action is left undone because the timing was missed.
mistake: It is not simply failing despite a completed attempt.
